scope: Source-level audit and focused hardening of the owner-local menu and recovery status. No public route or execution gate changed.

issues.finding: Open at Login uses a manually written LaunchAgent rather than the app-associated SMAppService registration and status path available on macOS 13 and later.
issues.disposition: Deferred until the local app has a stable signing and bundled-helper distribution path; retain the current owner-session behavior meanwhile.

issues.finding: The cold-start progress window has a fixed height and has not been visually checked with enlarged text or translated copy.
issues.disposition: Keep bounded to a later native UI pass; current English content fits the source constraints, but no screenshot evidence is claimed.

positiveFindings: The app uses AppKit menus, NSAlert, NSProgressIndicator, system colors and SF Symbols.
Relay and monitor health are checked independently; network work is asynchronous and subprocess output is discarded.
The menu separates service supervision from opening the menu app at login, and does not expose keys or raw operational errors.
The supervisor uses bounded jittered retries, a shared launcher lock and owner-only atomic state.

hardening: Added a 15-second private supervisor heartbeat during waits so long bounded backoff is not misreported as a stopped or stale supervisor.
The menu now distinguishes active, recovering, stopped and non-reporting supervisor states, and shows the next retry estimate and attempt count.
Menu-bar status refreshes the private supervisor summary when opened.
Both login preference handlers validate the expected LaunchAgent identity and command; conflicting entries are left untouched, and the menu app preference file is owner-only.

verification.nativeBundleBuild: passed; both local app bundles signed and installed

limits: The audit is source-level; visual capture was unavailable in this session.
ACT-018 remains open for sign-in, host/daemon restart, Docker/Colima failure injection, sleep/wake, closed-lid and duplicate-owner drills.
No provider generation, account mutation, public ingress change or execution-gate change was performed.
